Overview 
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 
 The Purview Integration platform team will make Purview protections native across Microsoft apps and AI surfaces. It aims to replace fragmented integrations and inconsistent enforcement with shared infrastructure and measurable coverage. · Shared protection platform: The team would provide a common SDK and integration contract for DLP enforcement, classification signals, RMS encryption and usage rights, plus telemetry and onboarding tools. Its planned reach includes Office apps, Outlook, Copilot surfaces, Autopilot and future agent harnesses. Milestones include a Q1 SDK, two adopted surfaces in Q2, and later work on policy parity, protected AI output, self-service onboarding, coverage telemetry and performance; numeric targets remain placeholders. Ownership and delivery model: The proposed team includes an engineering manager and specialists for the SDK, AI harnesses, Office and Outlook, telemetry and reliability, and onboarding. It would embed during each surface’s first integration and own the contract, SDK and conformance bar; Purview core teams retain policy semantics, while surface teams own UX and rollout after conformance.


 Responsibilities 
 AI-Native Development: Uses AI and GenAI tools responsibly across the software development lifecycle, reviewing AI-generated changes for correctness, security, and quality. Coding & Engineering: Builds clean, maintainable, and extensible code using established coding patterns, engineering best practices, and modern development tools. Quality & Reliability: Develops testable software, uses automated testing and code-analysis tools, and applies debugging, logging, telemetry, and diagnostics to identify and resolve issues. Design & Architecture: Contributes to feature design and technical validation while considering performance, scalability, resiliency, cost, security, privacy, and compliance. Collaboration & Growth: Participates in code reviews, incident retrospectives, and cross-team development; incorporates feedback, identifies dependencies, and escalates blockers and technical risks appropriately.


 Qualifications 
 Required/minimum qualifications
 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.
 Additional or preferred qualifications
 Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field with proven experience coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 2+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.

 

 Software Engineering IC2 - The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $85,400 - $168,100 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $111,100 - $183,700 per year. 
 
 Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. Find additional benefits and pay information here:
 https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/us-corporate-pay 

 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
